source: Owner-provided 1440 map reference and owner-approved correction: the reference label Golden Horde is a legacy regional label, represented by one Great Horde country; the visible Nogai zone is a separate gameplay country. Approximate longitude bands adapt source Golden Horde cells; no third-party province geometry copied. Scandinavian cells labelled Kalmar Union are partitioned into Denmark, Norway and Sweden under the owner’s explicit separate-country rule; borders are gameplay approximations.

capital_proxy_notes.gth: The closest current settlement cell to the lower-Volga Sarai complex is used as an in-map capital proxy; the meridian bands remain otherwise in effect.
capital_proxy_notes.cri: Dzhankoy is the nearest existing province cell to Solkhat/Qrïm; it is a gameplay capital proxy.
capital_proxy_notes.nog: Atyrau is used as a current-map proxy near the historic Manghit/Saray-Jük area.

rules.approximation_note: Great Horde owns the western band and listed North Caucasus cells; Nogai Horde occupies the 44–52°E band; Uzbek Khanate occupies the eastern band from 52°E plus the Tura/Sibir extension. These are gameplay approximations guided by the owner image, not surveyed 1440 borders. A local Age of Civilizations II 1440 comparison reviewed 80 high-confidence steppe cells; the proprietary source files are not redistributed. Bremen and Hamburg own only their named city cells as municipal gameplay approximations; their disputed 1440 legal status and mixed surrounding cells are not inferred from the game map.
rules.legacy_map_label: Golden Horde is a legacy regional label; represent the country as the Great Horde (gth).
rules.kalmar_partition_note: All 139 coarse Kalmar source cells are split by these owner-directed rules: named Denmark/Norway exceptions, a hand-drawn Norway/Sweden longitude boundary, and Sweden for remaining cells. Denmark includes the southern Scanian/Blekinge/Halland overrides; Norway includes Faroe, Orkney, Shetland and Jämtland proxies. This is a campaign approximation, not a verified 1440 boundary dataset. Iceland is outside the current raster extent.

fallback.method: For unowned HRE coarse cells, use nearest represented HRE member by shortest map-graph path; for other unmatched or unrepresented cells, use nearest existing country by shortest map-graph path. If a low-confidence polygon names an existing scenario country, prefer that named match when overlap is nonzero.
fallback.tie_break: lexicographically smallest country tag at equal graph distance
fallback.limitations: No HRE umbrella country is created. Microstates absent from the scenario are represented by the nearest currently modeled HRE member (Austria, Brandenburg, Burgundy, Luxembourg, Milan, or Savoy); non-member neighbors such as Florence and Venice cannot receive HRE fallback cells. This completes gameplay ownership but does not assert exact 1440 borders.
